technique.summary: Skip or reorder steps in multi-step workflows by directly accessing later-stage endpoints without completing prerequisite steps. This can bypass validation, payment, or approval steps.
steps: Map the complete workflow (e.g., registration → verification → approval → active)
Identify all endpoints involved in each step
Try accessing step N+1 directly without completing step N
Try accessing the final confirmation/completion endpoint directly
Try replaying a previous step's response to skip validation
Test if state is tracked server-side or client-side (JWT, cookies, hidden fields)
If client-side: modify the state token to indicate a later step

payloads.notes: Skip payment step — go directly to order completion
Directly set status bypassing approval workflow

bypassTechniques: Modify step/stage parameters in cookies or hidden form fields
Replay earlier responses with modified step numbers
Use API directly instead of the UI (UI may enforce step order, API may not)
Test with different HTTP methods — GET may skip validation that POST enforces
